records.name: Tempus
records.description: Rectal resection block B4 collected 22 October 2024: targeted tumour/normal DNA testing and bulk RNA. The matched-normal specimen is blood collected 28 January 2025. Separate plasma xM / Personalis testing is represented in an amended report with its original PPM unit.

records.name: Caris
records.description: Initial rectal biopsy collected 27 March 2024, plus a separate set of DNA/RNA outputs whose specimen linkage remains unresolved. These sets are kept separate. Separate Caris Assure plasma testing is represented with low-fraction and indeterminate-result limitations; no unresolved sequencing files are assigned to that report.

records.name: Natera
records.description: Assay-design tumour and matched-normal exomes, with file roles verified from retained analysis records, plus serial Signatera plasma results. The Signatera report identifies rectal resection block B7, collected 22 October 2024, as design tissue; the block-to-BAM link remains inferred.

records.name: Valius / Kandinsky / BostonGene
records.description: Multiple specimens: Valius single-cell summaries from liver resected 22 October 2024; IHC from liver block C4; BostonGene DNA/RNA from rectal resection block B4 with a saliva normal. Combined portal exports retain these distinctions.

records.name: TrufflePig
records.description: Exploratory analysis report. Research findings are kept distinct from clinically validated results; sample attribution follows the report.

records.name: JLF
records.description: Peptide-vaccine candidate design based on historical sequencing. Candidate lists do not establish the composition of a manufactured or administered vaccine.

records.name: Invoke Bio / Aureon
records.description: Multi-sample research and vaccine-design analysis using earlier sequencing. Supported primary-biopsy inputs are distinguished from normal material whose origin remains unresolved.

records.name: Clinical records & imaging
records.description: Clinical timeline, radiology and pathology compiled from source records and labelled patient reports. Individual records retain their source and date.

records.name: Cross-provider research & documentation
records.description: Curated tables connecting multiple providers and specimens. These are project-derived datasets, not a new laboratory assay.

records.name: Guardant Health
records.description: Guardant360 Liquid report with assay-specific low-tumor-fraction limitations.
